name: Bloodfen Burrow
summary: Bloodfen raptors now crowd the cavern and clearing in southwestern Dustwallow Marsh. They have overrun the ruins of a settlement that once struggled to survive the wetlands.

sections.title: A Den of Predators
sections.body: Bloodfen raptors crowd the cave and hollow in southwestern Dustwallow Marsh. The sheltered crevice and rich hunting grounds draw the pack. Outside the entrance, scattered debris and splintered remains mark an unidentified settlement. Travelers also whisper that Cortello, an adventurous buccaneer, left one of his hidden riddle clues somewhere in the den.

faq.answer: Bloodfen raptors overrun the cave and surrounding clearing. Their nesting ground is dense, and they attack anyone who enters their territory.

faq.q: What are the ruins outside the cave?
aliases: who built the huts near bloodfen burrow
faq.answer: The ruins outside the cave are all that remains of an unidentified settlement. Raptors destroyed it, and no record names its occupants or tells what became of them.

faq.q: Why would an adventurer search Bloodfen Burrow?
faq.answer: Explorers seeking Cortello's Riddle must enter Bloodfen Burrow to find one of the buccaneer's hidden clues. Fierce marsh raptors draw hunters to the cavern as well.

angles.text: As a hunter, you may find fierce, quick Bloodfen raptors here. They make durable, aggressive swamp companions.
